_comment: Known pyright error counts per package, per file. These are pre-existing and
accepted; `tools/check_pyright.py` fails only when a file EXCEEDS its entry or
a file not listed here reports an error. When you legitimately fix errors, lower
the numbers here in the same commit — the script tells you which line to change.

packages/cookbot-core.//cookbot/protocols/ws_messages.py: TYPE_CHECKING-only `from fastapi import WebSocket`. cookbot-core deliberately does not depend on fastapi (only clients do), so pyright cannot resolve it in this venv. Correct as written — do not add the dep to silence it.
